hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -Eq '(\.pdf$|\.csv$|(^|/)CoWork/)' && { echo 'BLOCKED: sensitive work data (*.pdf, *.csv, CoWork/) is never editable via Claude. Use /fixture-scrub to create a sanitized fixture under examples/ instead.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *js/parser.js) node specs/PAP-1-build-pan-auth-tracker-mvp/artifacts/smoke/parser-row-regex.test.mjs ;; *js/csv.js) node specs/PAP-1-build-pan-auth-tracker-mvp/artifacts/smoke/csv.test.mjs ;; *js/store.js) node specs/PAP-1-build-pan-auth-tracker-mvp/artifacts/smoke/store.test.mjs ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
